sentenceSets.sentence: The piebald horse trotted across the field, its brown and white patches creating a striking appearance that made it recognizable from great distances.

answerChoices.reasoning: Though spotted horses have distinctive marks, the sentence emphasizes two large patches of distinct colors rather than multiple small spots scattered across the body.
While dappled describes patches of color, it typically refers to softer, more subtle patterns than the bold, contrasting brown and white patches specifically described.
Though mottled denotes patches, the sentence emphasizes two specific contrasting colors in clear definition rather than the blotchy, unclear pattern that mottled usually implies.
Though marked indicates distinctive coloring, the sentence specifically requires two distinct color patches of substantial size rather than simply distinctive marks.
The sentence describes patches or blocks of color, not the linear patterns that striped animals display.
Though brindle is a color pattern, it refers to a weaving of colors typical in dogs and cattle rather than the large distinct patches described in this horse.
The sentence shows two large recognizable patches of color, not the small scattered spots that speckled indicates.
While flecked indicates marks, the sentence emphasizes large, recognizable patches of color rather than scattered small flecks.
The sentence explicitly describes patches of two different colors, which directly contradicts a single uniform color.
The sentence shows brown and white colors in distinct patches, opposite to a single-color appearance.
The sentence describes striking patches creating a distinctive appearance, opposite to a solid unchanging surface.

sentenceSets.sentence: The piebald approach to healthcare mixed traditional medicine with modern pharmaceuticals, pleasing neither purists nor progressives.

answerChoices.reasoning: Though hybrid means combining two elements, the sentence emphasizes that the combination creates displeasure from both sides, suggesting incongruity rather than a functional synthesis.
While eclectic means drawing from various sources, the sentence emphasizes conflict between incompatible systems rather than simply gathering diverse elements.
Though amalgamated means combined, the sentence shows the combination creates displeasure, indicating the elements are incongruous rather than smoothly merged.
Though mixed means combined, the sentence emphasizes inherent conflict between traditional and modern approaches rather than simply putting them together.
While composite means made of parts, the sentence emphasizes the incongruity of the parts rather than their assembly into a single entity.
Though blended suggests smooth combination, the sentence shows the elements please neither faction, indicating they do not blend harmoniously.
While synthesized means combined into a coherent whole, the sentence shows the combination is incoherent and causes displeasure.
Though integrated means unified into a system, the sentence shows disunity and displeasure, indicating the approaches have not become integrated.
The sentence describes mixing traditional and modern approaches, directly opposite to uniform composition throughout.
The sentence shows incompatible approaches being combined, opposite to following a single consistent approach.
The sentence shows deviation from any standard approach, opposite to following established standards.

sentenceSets.sentence: The piebald nature of the settlement—half-modern high-rises butting against century-old brick buildings—reflected decades of haphazard urban development.

answerChoices.reasoning: Though discordant means lacking harmony, the sentence focuses on the physical appearance and architectural styles rather than on discord or disagreement between elements.
While clashing suggests incompatibility in appearance, the sentence emphasizes the coexistence of different architectural periods rather than elements actively clashing.
Though fractured means broken into parts, the sentence shows distinct old and new sections coexisting rather than a unified whole being broken.
While mismatched means unsuitably combined, the sentence emphasizes the haphazard development creating visual contrast rather than items being selected and poorly paired.
Though chaotic means disordered, the sentence shows the settlement reflects decades of development with a discernible pattern rather than pure disorder.
While jumbled means mixed confusedly, the sentence shows distinct architectural sections rather than confused mixing of elements.
Though disparate means essentially different, the sentence emphasizes the visual contrast of architectural styles rather than the essential differences between things.
While layered suggests successive additions building cohesively, the sentence emphasizes incompatible architectural styles that don't harmonize.
The sentence describes high-rises butting against old brick buildings in an unattractive juxtaposition, opposite to harmonious architectural design.
The sentence shows haphazard development creating a mixed appearance, directly opposite to orderly or carefully planned arrangement.
The sentence describes incompatible architectural styles existing together, opposite to a coherent unified design.
